info.title: GCA - Deploy Pipeline
info.description: Authenticated custom connector for the Graph Connector Agent deploy pipeline. Exposes three operations requiring OAuth: deploy a connector (chains Connector Deploy Agent + App Registration Agent), check name conflicts, and list Power Platform environments. All operations forward the caller's bearer token for OBO authentication.

post.description: Deploy a generated Power Platform custom connector and configure its Entra ID app registration in a single call. Uses OAuth authentication to authorize the deploy operation. Chains: Connector Deploy Agent then App Registration Agent.

baseName.description: Validated connector display name. Used as-is for the connector and app registration — no suffix is appended.

authType.description: Auth type for the deployed connector: NoAuth, OAuthAAD, or FederatedIdentity.

swaggerUrl.description: URL to the generated Swagger definition (from graph_generateConnector Gist URL).

apiDefinition.description: Inline Swagger JSON string. Use this OR swaggerUrl, not both. Named 'apiDefinition' to avoid Swagger 2.0 reserved word collision.

200.description: Deploy pipeline result with connector and app registration details.

status.description: Overall pipeline status: success, partial, or error.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the deploy pipeline result.

post.description: Deploy multiple Power Platform custom connectors and their Entra ID app registrations in a single call. Accepts a JSON string of groups (each with baseName and swaggerUrl from batch generate results), deploys each sequentially via the CDA→ARA pipeline, and returns results as a JSON string for Parse value node consumption.

groupsJson.description: JSON string containing an array of connector groups. Each group has baseName (string) and swaggerUrl (string, from batch generate results). Example: [{"baseName":"Users","swaggerUrl":"https://gist.githubusercontent.com/..."},{"baseName":"Groups","swaggerUrl":"https://gist.githubusercontent.com/..."}]

authType.description: Auth type for deployed connectors: NoAuth, OAuthAAD, or FederatedIdentity.

successCount.description: Number of groups that deployed successfully

resultsJson.description: JSON string containing per-group deploy results array. Each item has baseName, status, connectorId, connectorDisplayName, appRegistrationAppId, and optional error. Use Parse value node with sample JSON to convert to typed Table.

get.description: Returns available Power Platform environments for the deployment picker. Proxies to the Connector Deploy Agent's connector_listEnvironments tool via A2A. Requires authentication to authorize the downstream call.

get.summary: Check connector and app registration names
get.description: Pre-flight name conflict check. Verifies that proposed connector base names do not conflict with existing connectors in the target Power Platform environment or existing app registrations in Entra ID. Returns per-name conflict status with suggested alternatives. Requires authentication to query downstream CDA and ARA agents.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Target Power Platform environment ID (GUID) to check connector names against.

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of proposed connector base names to check (e.g. 'Users Read,Users Write').

resultsJson.description: JSON-serialized array of per-name conflict check results. Each item has: name, connectorConflict (bool), connectorMatch (string|null), crossCollision (bool), appRegConflict (bool), appRegMatch (string|null), suggestedName (string|null), suggestedAppRegName (string|null).

hasConflicts.description: True if any name has a connector conflict or cross-collision.

conflictCount.description: Number of names with connector conflicts or cross-collisions.
